scripts.preinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const pkg=require('./package.json'); const pr=pkg.devDependencies?.['@vitejs/plugin-react']||pkg.overrides?.['@vitejs/plugin-react']||''; if(pr!=='4.2.1'){console.error('ERROR: @vitejs/plugin-react must be exactly 4.2.1. Found:', pr); process.exit(1);} console.log('Preinstall: ensuring @vitejs/plugin-react is pinned to 4.2.1');"
scripts.prepare: node -e "try{require.resolve('vite5/package.json');console.log('vite5 alias present');}catch(e){console.log('Installing vite5 alias...');process.exit(1);}" || npm i -D vite5@npm:vite@5.4.11
scripts.postinstall: node -e "try{const v5=require('vite5/package.json').version; if(!/^5\./.test(v5)){console.error('ERROR: vite5 alias resolved to '+v5+' but must be 5.x'); process.exit(1);} const pr=require('@vitejs/plugin-react/package.json').version; if(pr!=='4.2.1'){console.error('ERROR: @vitejs/plugin-react resolved to '+pr+' but must be 4.2.1'); process.exit(1);} console.log('Postinstall verified vite5', v5, 'and @vitejs/plugin-react', pr); }catch(e){console.error('postinstall check failed', e?.message||e); process.exit(1);}"
